title: LyricsProcessed
description: Published by Lyrics on routing key lyrics.processed once a song's lyrics are stored and retrievable from GET /api/lyrics/songs/{song_id}/lyrics. Catalogue sets lyrics_status = READY. May be published again for the same song (duplicate SongUploaded delivery); consumers must be idempotent.

line_count.description: Number of timestamped lyric lines stored. 0 for a song uploaded without lyrics (instrumental).

mood.description: Derived mood label from lyrics text, e.g. melancholy, romantic, energetic, chill, focus.
